summary: Fixed level-to-tier policy table (#1355): junior→T1, senior→T2, staff→T3 or human; risk:critical human approval; junior docs/tests cheapest start tier; enforced in task spec validator with schema metadata.
migration_impact: Task specs that violate the level/tier band or junior docs/tests start rules fail gh plate tasks validate. Pass issue_labels when validating dispatch tied to risk:critical issues.
migration_guidance: 1. Keep model_policy.tiers within the allowed set for each level (see level_tier_policy_table() or router design doc).
2. Set start_tier at or below the level default; junior docs/tests must use the cheapest listed tier.
3. When routing from risk:critical issues, set approval to human-t3 or stronger.
agent_notes: Policy matches agent-crews.md #1327 decisions. No new GitHub labels beyond optional tier:T0-T3.
